originalOcr.heading: Original OCR (immutable)
originalOcr.missingSnapshot: Older revisions do not have a separate original OCR snapshot. New revisions will store immutable original OCR.

legend.description: Green indicates a verified Admin/reference or engines agreeing precisely at the word level with valid alignment, token mapping, and bbox/crop; agreement is good evidence, not equivalent to Admin verified. Yellow is for words lacking evidence, disagreeing, or with unsafe mapping/quality. Red appears only when a candidate fails to match a verified reference in a clear one-to-one alignment.
